title: SENTINEL AI
caption: Rules decide. AI explains. Humans authorize.
narration: A Singapore bank has to hold a transfer that drains more than half of a fifty thousand dollar account within twenty four hours. This is SENTINEL AI: a real-time fraud operations control tower. Here is what that control looks like when it actually works, and when the analyst can see why.

title: Normal operations
caption: Live stream across three synthetic institutions
narration: The control tower shows live payment decisions across three participating institutions. Everything here is synthetic. Most transfers are allowed. Seeded background noise scores elevated and never reaches a hold, because a system that alarms on everything proves nothing.

title: Pre-transaction decision API
caption: ALLOW or HOLD before the transfer commits
narration: Every transfer calls a pre-transaction decision API, called by our simulator, before it settles. Seven pure rules score it, and a deterministic policy gate decides. No language model is anywhere in this path.

title: Rapid-drain gate: HOLD
caption: 65.4% of S$52,000 moved in 24 hours. Gate: 50%
narration: Here is the takeover. A login from an unseen device, a new payee, then rapid transfers. The fourth transfer moves sixty five point four percent of the opening balance in twenty four hours. Rule S G R D fifty fires, and the transfer is held before it settles. The decision trace shows the rule, the evidence and the policy version, as a fact, not a probability.

title: Deterministic attribution
caption: Score 95: every point traced to a rule
narration: The investigation workspace opens with the evidence bundle and the score of ninety five, broken down rule by rule. Rapid depletion, new device, new beneficiary, velocity, a suspicious entity relationship and behavioural deviation. The contributions are written once by the engine and never changed.

title: AI explains
caption: Gemini on Vertex AI. Advisory only. Every claim cites evidence.
narration: Now the AI explains. Gemini on Vertex AI receives the evidence bundle and returns a structured case summary. Every claim must cite a field in that bundle, or it is removed. Gemini cannot change a score, and it never recommends releasing a hold.

title: Network and fund trace
caption: Cross-bank trace with an explicit observed boundary
narration: The network view unfolds across three institutions, with the provenance of every link. Trace funds follows the money out of the account, and stops where observation stops. Cross-bank trace reconstructed from each institution's own events, with an explicit observed boundary. We never invent a hop.

title: Humans authorize
caption: Contact customer, kill switch, verified release. All audited.
narration: SENTINEL applies the configured policy automatically. Authorised bank operators manage verification, escalation and exceptions. The analyst records a customer contact, and can switch on an account kill switch with a reason and a second confirmation. Only the customer's verification with the bank lifts it.

title: One-click case report
caption: Generated from recorded facts. Edited, signed off, exported as PDF
narration: One click generates the case report from the recorded facts: summary, timeline, risk evidence, interventions and the network. The analyst writes the recommendation and signs off. A signed version can never change, and it exports as a PDF.

title: Bank lens and audit
caption: Designed as a multi-tenant platform; demonstrated as a single deployment on synthetic data.
narration: Viewed as another bank, the servers mask that bank's accounts and withhold its transactions, and every refused request is audited. Designed as a multi-tenant platform, demonstrated as a single deployment on synthetic data.

title: SENTINEL AI
caption: Detect. Explain. Intervene. Investigate.
narration: Built on Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Pub Sub, Vertex AI Gemini and MongoDB Atlas. Four hundred and five automated tests pass. Rules decide. AI explains. Humans authorize. This is SENTINEL AI.
